population_accounting.owner_target: Continuous expansion: discover, index and individually review every distinct eligible skill in each declared snapshot, while adding new sources, skills and revisions
population_accounting.counting_rule: Do not use 995 as the full discovered corpus denominator; do not treat source-vetting-only decisions as exact-version semantic reviews.
population_accounting.registered_or_tracked_source_package_den: 20 source-family eligible/denominator counters in main index.json; excludes first-party 44 and candidate-only 121; not a unique corpus-wide count
registered_or_tracked_source_package_den: Microsoft Azure skills mirror 33 Microsoft skills identities; do not sum as unique packages
The 995 third-party review records include 121 candidate-only reviews and can include different revisions or mirrors
Registered/tracked source packages are not all discovered or referenced external skill packages

workflow: Enumerate each registered source's exact first-class SKILL.md paths at recorded pin
Attach exact package fingerprint and provenance
Identify mirrored packages and revision duplicates without deleting records
Crosswalk each unique eligible identity to capabilities
Record exact-version static review decisions and distinct security/behavioral evidence
reconciliation_program.acceptance: Never calculate a corpus-wide fixed-target reviewed percentage from historical review counts; report snapshot-scoped coverage once each denominator is reconciled, and separately report discovery expansion and unknown coverage

population_accounting.success_definition: Snapshot-specific: complete identity enumeration plus individual evidence-backed terminal review states; ecosystem-wide: breadth, freshness, capability access, legal/operational usability, discovery backlog and new-intake throughput; no fixed all-time skill count
population_accounting.discovery_scope_note: Four current discovery-only source snapshots list 4813 raw SKILL.md paths, 4537 direct-shape; not a deduplicated eligible package denominator, not a fixed volume target

discovery_manifests.role: additional discovery-only exact-pinned path/shape listings; NOT capability-verified or eligible for unchanged use
discovery_manifests.scope: Four pinned dynamic-discovery sources, not an all-time target or reviewed/eligible denominator
discovery_manifests.path_lookup_procedure: Read the source manifest from entry.sources[].manifest; for chunked indexes follow parts[]; compare capability terms, inspect exact upstream package, provenance, rights, authority, and qualification independently
